title: schizoglossum stenoglossum subsp. flavum
intro: Schizoglossum stenoglossum subsp. flavum, commonly known as Yellowish Tongue Flower, is a plant species within the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Schizoglossum stenoglossum subsp. flavum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
